thread:
mike: Heads up — acme reserved pool p95 spiked after merge #3032. Observed p95 went from ~120ms -> ~420ms on long-seq workloads. Looks like kernel selector switched to slow-path for heavy sequences and KV cache miss rate increased.

tara: Is this only on the dedicated/reserved pools or broader?

mike: Only reserved pools for Acme (us-east-1). Hosted/ephemeral lanes unaffected. Repro locally with longseq harness. Attached quick profiler snippet below.

ivan: Did CI catch this? I thought nightly perf flagged something.

mike: nightly-x86 perf did show ~8% p95 regression on longseq but job was marked flaky and merge landed. The PR was the autobatch/kernel hint change (author: jess, PR 3032).

jess: I pushed the heuristic to reduce cost for short sequences; looks like the selector mis-classifies heavy sequences when combined with continuous batching >8, routing them to the merged slow kernel. KV cache miss rate jumped from 18% -> 46% on the traces I pulled.

nora: Can we hotpatch by forcing a kernel hint on the pool? If we set kernel_hint=legacy-fast and disable autokernel for the pool that should be immediate mitigation.

mike: Trying override now:

```bash
redwoodctl config set --pool acme-reserved kernel_hint=legacy-fast autokernel=false
```

mike: Applied to one node copy. Early numbers: p95 dropped to ~150ms on that node for longseq. Need to roll the override to all nodes in the pool.

ivan: I have a bisect script ready. Bisect range should be commit A (pre-3032) .. commit B (post-3032). This will tell us whether the selector change is the root cause.

jess: Agree. Also we should hold the dedicated rollout for other reserved pools until we confirm. I can open a revert PR if needed (3041 prepared).

tara: Pause rollout for the acme reserved capacity and disable any auto-rollout. CLI command:

```bash
redwoodctl rollout pause --target reserved/acme
```

jess: Hold added in console for reserved/acme. Running bisect now with the longseq perf test: 

```bash
scripts/ci_perf_bisect --range <hashA>..<hashB> --test longseq_p95 --output /tmp/bisect-results.json
```

deploy-bot: Deploy paused for reserved/acme by tara at 2026-03-18T14:23:05Z

nora: I'll draft a short customer note for Acme and loop in support. @support please prepare to send if we don't have a full mitigation in 1h.

mike: Action items: 1) keep rollout paused (tara) 2) cluster-wide kernel override if we need immediate mitigation (mike/nora) 3) run bisect and confirm offending commit (ivan/jess) 4) prepare revert PR or rollback plan (jess) 5) notify CS/SRE and affected customers (nora).

jess: Estimated turnaround: kernel override -> ~30m to propagate; revert PR + QA -> 1-2h. If bisect pins it to 3032 we should revert and cut a hotfix release.

ivan: Starting bisect now, will post step results here. First pass will run per-node longseq_p95 with 3 repeats.

tara: Thanks. Please paste any perf numbers here as they come in, and add raw profiler dumps to the eng-runtime perf board. :thumbsup:

mike: Will do. First bisect batch queued.
